test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All K are H.

II. No S is K.

**Conclusion:**

I. No K is S.

II. All H are K.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/596df94a972ad0fe8f6d18354340fed0ceb4e70f5e9e1c7f427f64749a6f38b9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No K is S → Follow (As no S is K. So, it is definitely true)

II. All H are K → Does not follow (As all K are H. So, it is possible but not definitely true therefore it is definitely false)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion I follows**".
